rec.name: PDP Gallery Image Info Bar with "More Info" Button

what.text: A slim info bar overlaid at the bottom of selected product-gallery images. It shows a short benefit/feature title (e.g. "Erkennen & Begreifen"), a "Mehr info" underlined link and a round black "i" icon button. Each bar is a reusable metaobject assigned to a specific gallery image, so not every image needs one. The bar height adapts to the number of text lines.

why.text: It adds a benefit or feature message right at the moment the shopper looks at the product image, without cluttering the photo. The "i" icon and "Mehr info" link invite a low-effort click for those who want detail, which reduces uncertainty and communicates value (such as the educational benefit of a toy). Progressive disclosure keeps the gallery clean.

how.text: Create an "Info button / info bar" metaobject type (title, text content, icon) and attach metaobjects as a list to the product. Match each active metaobject to a gallery image in order, and render it as an overlay strip at the bottom of the image. Clicking "Mehr info" or the icon opens more detail (the exact behavior, such as a popup or drawer, is not shown in the ticket). Draft metaobjects are skipped and the next active one takes its place, so order is managed by dragging and dropping active metaobjects in the product's list. Mobile styling: regular-weight (non-bold) title and a smaller icon. The bar's background and height grow dynamically with the text line count.

items: Draft/active status per info bar (draft is skipped)
Info text content (behavior of the "Mehr info" action not shown)
Mobile: regular-weight title and smaller icon

dependencies.text: Shopify metaobjects (info button definition) and a product metafield referencing a list of those metaobjects. Custom Liquid/JS in the product media gallery. Order is based on the sequence of active metaobjects, not a fixed image index, so the same info button can be reused across products. A custom index field was considered but rejected because it would break reuse.

items: Add-to-cart rate on PDPs with vs. without info bars

images.caption: Mobile PDP gallery: light-blue info bar under the first image with bold title "Erkennen & Begreifen", underlined "Mehr info" link and black round "i" icon.
Mobile PDP view after the update: regular-weight title and smaller "i" icon, bar sits at the bottom of the gallery image above the pagination dots.
